title: Listen and Repeat drill 1

listen_repeat_parts.intro: You are training to help new students at the university's student services center. Listen to the coordinator and repeat what she says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Please take a number at the front desk.
The career office is open until five.
Students can't pick up their ID cards without a signed form.
The housing team answers questions about rent and room changes.
You can book a meeting with an adviser on the portal.
The study lounge on the second floor offers free coffee, printing, and quiet rooms for group work.
Students who miss the registration deadline must submit a late request to the main office.

listen_repeat_parts.intro: You are learning to assist visitors at the university's chemistry laboratory. Listen to the lab manager and repeat what he says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Safety glasses must be worn at all times.
Coats and bags go in the lockers by the door.
Never pour chemicals down the sink without asking first.
The fume hood removes harmful gases from the air you breathe.
Report any spill to the lab manager right away.
Rinse your eyes at the eyewash station for at least fifteen minutes if chemicals get in them.
Students who finish early can clean their equipment and return it to the storage room.

outro: This is the end of the Listen and Repeat practice.
